attackers_goals: An attacker may attempt to gain access to the account and escalate privileges.
description: A user enabled a default local account. Enabling a default account may pose a security risk, as they are often exploited by attackers.
investigative_actions: Check what rights and permissions were granted to the user. Verify this action with the user who performed the change. Follow actions and activities of the newly enabled default account.
name: A user enabled a default local account
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
